tokens.name: seco-teal
tokens.usage: Logo green, taken from the logo files. The brand's one hue: primary buttons, the station frame, the big colour field in layouts. White text on it is 5.6:1. Not as small text on the dark surface (3.3:1): use brand-text there.

tokens.name: seco-graphite
tokens.usage: Logo grey, taken from the logo files: the dark facets of the mark. Secondary colour fields and print. White text on it is 7.6:1.

tokens.name: seco-graphite-soft
tokens.usage: Grey of the C and O in the wordmark. Only inside the logo artwork; never used for UI.

tokens.name: seco-black
tokens.usage: Ground of the reversed logo (seco-logo-reversed.png). Photographic and print backgrounds, not UI surfaces.

tokens.name: seco-white
tokens.usage: Ground of the primary logo and the mark (both files have a white background). Text on seco-teal and seco-graphite.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background. In light it is the same white as the logo files, so the primary logo sits on it without a visible box.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and table headers on surface.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Teal tint for selected rows, highlighted notes and quiet fields. Text on it: ink, ink-secondary or ink-muted only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, card and input borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface, surface-raised and brand-soft (12:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and descriptions on surface, surface-raised and brand-soft (8:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and placeholders on surface, surface-raised and brand-soft (4.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons, the active tab and brand bands. Text on it: on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills. Text on it: on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Teal as text, links and icons on surface and surface-raised (5.2:1 light, 7:1 dark). The dark theme lightens the logo teal so it stays legible.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-deep (5.6:1 and 7.3:1).

tokens.name: status-ready
tokens.usage: Station READY (Sẵn sàng). Dot and label on surface or surface-raised, always with the word.

tokens.name: status-charging
tokens.usage: Station CHARGING (Đang sạc) and live session values. Text on surface or surface-raised (4.8:1 or more), always with the word.

tokens.name: status-payment
tokens.usage: Guest session WAITING_PAYMENT (Chờ thanh toán), connector locked. Text on surface or surface-raised only (4.6:1 light), not on brand-soft.

tokens.name: status-maintenance
tokens.usage: Station MAINTENANCE (Bảo trì). Text on surface or surface-raised only (4.7:1 light), always with the word.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Station ERROR (Lỗi), safety trips, failed payments. Text on surface or surface-raised (5.3:1 or more), always with the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-offline
tokens.usage: Station OFFLINE (Mất kết nối): no heartbeat for 45 s. Text on surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable control; 4.8:1 or more on surface and surface-raised.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Covers, posters and the station decal headline. Few words, all caps.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section openers in decks and printed material.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles in the web admin and the app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Quẹt thẻ thành viên hoặc chọn ngân sách để bắt đầu sạc.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels and eyebrows; set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Station IDs, card UIDs, session IDs and aligned numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; gap in tight lists.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, horizontal button padding, minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; logo clear space around a 128px-wide lockup.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Print margins and cover insets.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Colour fields, the station decal, anything echoing the sharp facets of the mark.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills only.
